connector.name: Cryptair MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Tamper-evident attestation tools for AI agents - on-chain receipts on Hedera Hashgraph mainnet.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the syronius account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CRYPTAIR_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Pre-configured Cryptair API key. If unset, the agent can call register_agent at runtime to self-register and the key is silently stored at ~/.cryptair/credentials.json.

env.name: CRYPTAIR_EMAIL
env.description: Optional. Email used as fallback when submit_attestation auto-provisions a counterparty account.

env.name: CRYPTAIR_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional. Override the API base URL for self-hosted or staging environments. Defaults to https://www.cryptair.io.
